steps.body: About This Mac: use arm64 for an Apple chip, or x64 for Intel.
steps.title: Check your computer
steps.verifierLabel: You know which installer matches your computer

steps.body: Choose Ghost-0.1.5-mac-arm64.dmg or Ghost-0.1.5-mac-x64.dmg for your chip.
steps.title: Download Ghost 0.1.5
steps.verifierLabel: The matching installer finished downloading

steps.body: Open your Downloads folder and find the Ghost installer.
steps.title: Find the download
steps.verifierLabel: You can see the downloaded file

steps.body: Open the DMG, then drag Ghost into Applications.
steps.title: Install Ghost
steps.verifierLabel: Ghost is installed

steps.body: If blocked, try Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. For “damaged”, follow the checksum guide.
steps.title: Open this unsigned release
steps.verifierLabel: You have handled any launch warning

steps.body: Open Ghost from Applications.
steps.title: Open Ghost
steps.verifierLabel: Ghost launches

steps.body: Choose your Mac/Windows and iPhone/Android combination in Ghost’s first-run survey.
steps.title: Choose your computer and phone
steps.verifierLabel: The checklist matches your computer and phone

steps.body: iPhone: enable Developer Mode and restart. Android: enable Developer options and USB debugging.
steps.title: Prepare your phone’s settings
steps.actionLabel: Read all four phone setup paths
steps.verifierLabel: You completed the steps for your phone

steps.body: Connect an unlocked phone with a data cable. Accept Trust or USB debugging on your phone.
steps.title: Connect and authorize USB
steps.verifierLabel: Your phone has authorized this computer

steps.body: Check off your completed setup steps, then click Continue to map.
steps.title: Continue to the map
steps.verifierLabel: The Ghost map and location controls are visible

steps.body: Select the phone in Ghost. If Setup needed appears, click Prepare while online.
steps.title: Prepare the connected phone
steps.verifierLabel: Ghost shows your selected phone as Ready

steps.body: Android only: allow Appium Settings location access and select it as the mock location app.
steps.title: Check Android’s location helper
steps.verifierLabel: Android is ready, or you are using iPhone

steps.body: Select Fixed location. Search and select a result, drop a map pin, or enter coordinates.
steps.title: Choose a fixed location
steps.verifierLabel: The pin marks the place you chose

steps.body: Check the phone and pin, then click Set location. A later change uses Update location.
steps.title: Send the location to your phone
steps.verifierLabel: Ghost shows an active session

steps.body: On the phone, allow map location access and tap current location. Confirm the selected area.
steps.title: Check the phone’s map
steps.verifierLabel: The phone’s map shows your chosen location

steps.body: Click Restore real location. Wait for the phone’s map to refresh.
steps.title: Restore before trying a route
steps.verifierLabel: Your phone has returned to its real location

steps.body: Select Route. Pick each stop, then click Add selected pin to route. Use at least two stops.
steps.title: Add a start and destination
steps.verifierLabel: Your start and destination appear in travel order

steps.body: Click Plan road route. Check the road line and distance before starting. Internet is required.
steps.title: Preview the road route
steps.verifierLabel: The planned road line and distance are visible

steps.body: Click Start route · 45 mph. Ghost sends a new route point every second.
steps.title: Start moving at 45 mph
steps.verifierLabel: Ghost shows Pause route and a moving blue dot

steps.body: Watch the phone’s map. Ghost’s dot shows sent points; it cannot verify what a phone app reads.
steps.title: Check movement on the phone
steps.verifierLabel: You have checked movement in the phone’s map

steps.body: Pause route holds the last point. Resume route · 45 mph continues along the road.
steps.title: Pause and resume
steps.verifierLabel: You can pause and resume the route

steps.body: Click Restore real location, then check the phone’s map before unplugging.
steps.title: Restore the real location
steps.verifierLabel: Simulation has stopped and the phone shows its real location

steps.body: Sleep or unplugging pauses routes. Reconnect the same phone, then Resume; use Restore when done.
steps.title: Know how to recover
steps.verifierLabel: You know how to reconnect or restore
